[EN] I haven't seen you around here...I don't know what you're doing here but don't do anything to interrupt my research.
[ES] No te he visto por aquí... No sé qué estás haciendo aquí, pero no hagas nada que interrumpa mi investigación.

[EN] I'm really grateful for everything you've done for us. But take it easy, don't overdo yourself.
[ES] Estoy muy agradecido por todo lo que has hecho por nosotros. Pero tómalo con calma, no te exijas demasiado.

[EN] Haha...I hear argon research is really going well thanks to you.

I don't know how to repay you for all you've done!
[ES] Jaja... ¡Escuché que la investigación sobre los argon va muy bien gracias a ti.

¡No sé cómo agradecerte todo lo que has hecho!

[EN] Haha...I hear argon research is really going well thanks to you.
